title: What Is Management? Explained Simply | Principles of Management Ep 1
description:
What is management, and why does every business need it? In this animated lesson we follow Ravi, who runs a busy chai stall, to understand management in the simplest way possible.

You will learn the meaning of management (getting things done through people), the difference between being effective and being efficient, and the 5 functions of management: planning, organizing, staffing, directing and controlling.

This is Episode 1 of our Principles of Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.

In this video:
0:00 A chai stall in chaos
0:17 Why Ravi needs management
0:21 What is management?
0:38 Effective vs efficient
0:53 The 5 functions of management
1:18 Results, and where else we use management
1:33 Quick check
1:46 Recap

Next episode: Nature, Scope and Importance of Management.
